name: bridgeapp
description: Connects Codex to a BridgeApp workspace over MCP — tasks, chats, threads, pages, and projects — with skills for the workflows around them.

interface.longDescription: Read and act on your BridgeApp workspace under your own account's permissions: tasks with their comments, subtasks, blockers and plan documents; chats and threads; pages; projects and their participants. The bundled skills teach Codex how to work from a task, read a thread to the end, create well-formed tasks, and build links back into the workspace.
